name: How long does interior painting typically take for a standard room?

mainEntity.name: How long does interior painting typically take for a standard room?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of interior painting for a standard room generally ranges from one to three days. This includes time for preparation, such as masking and minor repairs, applying primer if necessary, and two coats of paint. Larger rooms, intricate details, or extensive prep work can extend this timeline. We aim to complete projects efficiently while maintaining quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard room's interior painting typically takes one to three days, including prep and two coats of paint.
